label: Nexcomm Halo — temp/RH MQTT (base + X10)
notes: MQTT driver (read-only). Halo gateway publishes JSON to nexcomm/halo/<deviceId>/telemetry. Base unit: base.temp_C, base.rh_pct. Expansions X1–X10: Xn.temp_C, Xn.rh_pct. Set broker URL and deviceId when applying. Example payload in st/fixtures/halo-telemetry-sample.json.
